map.→ 打开 骑行齿比计算器 工具: -> Open the cycling gear ratio calculator tool
map.休闲骑行 80–90 rpm，冲刺可更高；过高踏频低效，过低伤膝。: Leisure riding 80-90 rpm, higher for sprints; too high a cadence is inefficient and too low stresses the knees.
map.公路车常用 50/34 牙盘配 11–28t 飞轮。: Road bikes commonly use a 50/34 chainring with an 11-28t cassette.
map.同踏频下齿比大速度快，但所需踩踏力也更大，爬坡会更吃力。: At the same cadence a larger gear ratio gives more speed but needs more pedal force, so climbing becomes harder.
map.大齿比适合平路冲刺；小齿比适合爬坡。: A large gear ratio suits flat sprints; a small one suits climbing.
map.结果区显示齿比、齿轮英寸与对应速度/踏频。: The result panel shows the gear ratio, gear inches and the corresponding speed / cadence.
map.轮周长需实测（轮胎充气后略有变化）；速度含滚阻与风阻近似，实测会略低。: Wheel circumference must be measured (it changes slightly once the tyre is inflated); the speed includes approximations for rolling and air resistance, so a measured value will be slightly lower.
map.输入牙盘、飞轮齿数与轮周长（或选预设轮径）。: Enter the chainring and cassette tooth counts and the wheel circumference (or pick a preset wheel diameter).
map.输入牙盘齿数、飞轮齿数与轮周长（或轮径），计算齿比、每圈行进距离（齿轮英寸）以及: Enter the chainring and cassette tooth counts and the wheel circumference (or diameter) to compute the gear ratio, the distance per revolution (gear inches) and the cycling speed at different cadences, supporting road and mountain bike selection and tuning.
map.输入目标踏频或目标速度。: Enter the target cadence or target speed.
map.齿比 = 牙盘 / 飞轮；每圈行进距离 = 齿比 × 轮周长；齿轮英寸 = 齿比: Gear ratio = chainring / cassette; distance per revolution = gear ratio x wheel circumference; gear inches = gear ratio x wheel diameter (in inches); speed = distance per revolution x cadence.
map.齿比越大骑得越快吗？: Does a larger gear ratio mean you ride faster?
